flags.why: The common derogatory use referring to a journalist is missing, as illustrated in [Sóng Trẻ](https://songtre.com.vn/nha-bao-hay-leu-bao-p4888.html).
flags.fix: Add noun [derogatory, slang]: hack journalist; incompetent or unscrupulous reporter.

flags.why: The common meaning of gifts or offerings, especially gifts to someone influential, is missing ([VDict](https://vdict.com/l%E1%BB%85%20l%E1%BA%A1t%2C3%2C0%2C0.html)).
flags.fix: Add noun: ceremonial gifts or offerings; gifts given to someone in authority.

flags.why: The example defines clerical script instead of showing the word in use.
flags.fix: Ông ấy viết câu đối bằng lệ thư. = He wrote the parallel couplets in clerical script.

flags.why: The term names bacillary dysentery, the disease caused by Shigella, rather than the bacterium ([Sức khỏe & Đời sống](https://suckhoedoisong.vn/chu-de/ly-truc-trung-ly-truc-khuan-1788.htm)).
The example incorrectly treats the disease name as the organism causing dysentery ([Sức khỏe & Đời sống](https://suckhoedoisong.vn/chu-de/ly-truc-trung-ly-truc-khuan-1788.htm)).
flags.fix: Bệnh nhân được chẩn đoán mắc lị trực khuẩn. = The patient was diagnosed with bacillary dysentery.

flags.why: The gloss confuses lọ mọ, which describes slow, persistent activity despite difficulty, with groping around in darkness ([Wiktionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/l%E1%BB%8D_m%E1%BB%8D)).
flags.fix: to potter about; to work or move slowly and persistently despite difficulty

flags.why: This name for a fishing trap is primarily Southern and needs a regional label ([Ca dao Mẹ](https://cadao.me/the/cai-lop/)).
The word describes teeth growing crookedly or out of line, especially displaced canines, rather than specifically buck teeth ([Nha khoa Hùng Cường](https://nhakhoahungcuong.com.vn/5460-2/)).
flags.fix: having crooked teeth growing out of line
